comments: Capacity-increase experiment at the SoC input resolution (8 Doppler x 64 Range, see kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64.json): doubles bottleneck_ch 64->128. Justification: at this input size the full model uses ~0.85M MACs (thop, native-res model uses ~436M) vs the 640M/inference budget, so MAC cost is not the binding constraint here -- but bottleneck_ch=96 was already a clean negative at native resolution (see kuralsnet_npu_seg_wide96.json) despite similar MAC headroom, and this input's bottleneck feature map is only (1, 8) spatially, i.e. very little spatial diversity to exploit regardless of channel count. This run tests whether widening still helps once the input itself (not the model) is the bottleneck -- not assumed to win. quant_warmup/freeze_iters extended to match wide96's mitigation for wider-model QAT instability.
